_doc: Clean Yap SPEC — the single source of truth for the trimmed-back yap format. Human doc: CLEANYAP.md. Engine: cleanyap.py. No ready-made per-reel driver ships: each reel gets a short driver calling cleanyap.py (see CLEANYAP.md, Run). NOT Super Yap (that's superyap.py, loaded).

format.name: Clean Yap
format.definition: trimmed-back: locked cut + ONE hook + thought bubbles (the pack's thought font) + matched SFX over full-screen footage. Everything individually editable. NOTHING loaded.

doneness._axis_note: Doneness (how baked) is a SEPARATE axis from format. A Clean Yap can be ANY of the three — the 'cooked' level is NOT a Super-Yap-only thing (locked). Pick per reel; default = raw.
doneness.raw: editable CapCut text (hook + thoughts as real text) + native Auto Captions. Engine = cleanyap.py. DEFAULT.
doneness.medium_well: hook / thoughts / captions rendered as Claude-built NAMED .mov layers (reposition/toggle, not retype); footage + SFX still editable. Engine = build-hf-captions.py -> build-overlay.py.
doneness.well_done: fully baked flat MP4, nothing editable. Engine = build-reel-type.py (HyperFrames render + ffmpeg).

jump_cuts.desc: gentle scale push-ins on accent beats for rhythm

intro_zoom._LOCKED: slow keyframed push-in on the OPENING clip — clean-yap default, ESP confessional (the creator's own)
intro_zoom.how: KFTypeScaleX keyframes on the first footage segment

hook.font: the pack's hook font (resolved per style pack)

position.note: top, in the measured open zone above her; never a typed number

hook.HOLD_RULE: hook HOLDS long through the opening (the creator extended it to ~20s on an example reel — do NOT drop it early).

thoughts.font: the pack's thought font (resolved per style pack)

position.note: ABOVE her head, NOT across her face; never a typed number

thoughts.line_spacing_note: TIGHT — the creator's own value; engine default 0.02 reads too loose for thought-bubble multi-line

intro_rotation._note: VARY the entrance animation (real resource_ids, from creative-vault/animations.json)

outro._LOCKED: bubbles FADE OUT (the creator) — and NO sound on the fade-out

thoughts.content_rule: deep, in-voice; scripture-rooted content must be biblically accurate (she vets); cut a bubble that CITES/labels rather than FEELS (she cut the parable-of-the-talents citation)
thoughts.front_engagement_bubble: optional viewer-contribution prompt near the front (e.g. 'what would you call this?')

sfx.source: the engine's own sound library: `python3 product/capcut_sfx.py --list` (her favorites first, then her own sfx/ folder, then the bundled set). The palette below names the kinds of sound; its hashes are CapCut cache ids from the machine they were captured on and are never looked up.
sfx.rule: NON-CARTOON unless she asks; sound matches motion — trim SFX to the EXACT animation length

LOCKED_default.woosh: RARE accent only — do NOT put a woosh on every exit (the creator called this out); you'll place the odd intentional one yourself

sfx.text_outro_default: NONE — bubbles fade out silent. (Earlier woosh-on-every-exit was too much.)

captions.engine: native CapCut Auto Captions (the creator runs in-app)
captions.style: Bold Text-Popup + Auto highlight keywords ON (bold-white pop + yellow keyword)
captions.rule: NEVER injected as text clips; on the whole reel

maintrack_ripple.desc: overlays + SFX must follow main-track ripple edits, like native CapCut
maintrack_ripple.status: CONFIRMED FIXED (locked). Enforced in every finalize so it never regresses.

finalize.engine: VectCutAPI :9001; fonts patched in (engine uses stand-in Inter_Black)

workflow.lock_cut_first: dress with overlays/SFX only AFTER the cut is locked
workflow.on_retrim: re-read your live draft and re-align overlays; NEVER rebuild over your live edits
